meta.notes: Rust rewrite. Git repo required to run.
meta.tldr: Codex-cli 0.151.0 introduces significant enhancements to tool discovery, extension capabilities, and plugin management, alongside crucial bug fixes for sandbox security and model reasoning. The headline feature is the new configurable grace period for discovering tools from optional MCP servers, allowing developers to fine-tune how long the CLI waits for external tool availability, which is vital for complex, distributed development environments. Extensions can now inspect or even replace MCP tool results before they reach the model, offering unprecedented control over tool output and enabling more sophisticated custom workflows and integrations. Plugin catalogs have been improved to combine per-repository configurations and intelligently report invalid project marketplaces without disrupting access to valid plugins, streamlining plugin discovery and management. Key bug fixes include preserving restored permission profiles across TUI turns and preventing the `/cd` command from inadvertently weakening sandbox restrictions, significantly bolstering security. Tool availability and reasoning effort are now correctly maintained when switching models or falling back, ensuring consistent agent behavior. Remote sandbox enforcement has been improved by using the executor’s actual home directory, operating system, and path conventions, leading to more robust and predictable sandboxed environments. Structured MCP tool and resource errors are now preserved in app-server responses, aiding in debugging, and nested subagent token usage is correctly counted toward root goal budgets. Additionally, stale Guardian classifications are prevented from authorizing actions after permission state changes, enhancing security. Telemetry has been added for escalated stdin reviews and remote executor MCP discovery, providing valuable insights for future improvements. Developers should upgrade to benefit from these security, stability, and extensibility improvements, especially those relying on MCP tools, custom extensions, or robust sandboxing.

features.description: Made MultiAgentV2 configuration more explicit with thread caps, wait-time controls, root/subagent hints, and v2-specific depth handling.

features.name: Modal Vim editing in composer
features.description: The TUI now supports modal Vim editing in the composer, including `/vim`, default-mode config, and Vim-specific keymap contexts.

features.name: TUI workflows resume/fork picker
features.description: TUI workflows are easier to resume and copy from with a redesigned resume/fork picker, raw scrollback mode, `/ide` context injection, and workspace-aware `/diff`.

features.name: Status line theme-aware colors
features.description: The status line can show theme-aware colors plus optional PR and branch-change summaries, and `/keymap debug` helps inspect terminal key events.

features.name: Plugin management workspace sharing
features.description: Plugin management now supports workspace sharing, share access controls, source filtering, local share path tracking, marketplace removal/upgrades, remote bundle sync, and admin-disabled status handling.

features.name: Hooks browsing and toggling
features.description: Hooks can be browsed and toggled from `/hooks`, can run before/after compaction, and can add `PreToolUse` context; Codex Apps auth and eligible MCP elicitations now surface through TUI/Guardian flows.

features.name: Experimental goals discoverable
features.description: Experimental goals are now discoverable, stay paused across resume unless the user opts back in, and show clearer validation and multi-day duration output.

features.name: Plugin Details and Sharing Enhancements
features.description: Plugin details now display bundled hooks, and plugin sharing exposes link metadata along with discoverability controls.

features.name: codex remote-control Command
features.description: Added `codex remote-control` as a simpler entrypoint for starting a headless, remotely controllable app-server.

features.name: App-server Thread Pagination APIs
features.description: App-server clients can now page large threads with unloaded, summary, or full turn item views.

features.name: AWS Login Credentials for Bedrock Auth
features.description: Bedrock authentication can now utilize AWS console-login credentials from `aws login` profiles.

features.name: view_image Environment Resolution
features.description: `view_image` can now resolve files through the selected environment for multi-environment sessions.

features.name: Richer TUI Session Controls
features.description: The TUI now offers richer session controls and display, including data-driven service-tier commands, blended token usage, permissions/approval mode, effective workspace roots, and responsive Markdown tables.

features.name: Unified Mentions Picker
features.description: `@` mentions now search files, directories, plugins, and skills in one picker, backed by app-server plugin metadata.

features.name: Plugin Workflows Enhancements
features.description: Plugin workflows gained marketplace CLI commands, version-aware sharing, share checkout, clearer shared-workspace buckets, and default-enabled plugin hooks.

features.name: Remote Workflows Enhancements
features.description: Remote workflows now support daemon-managed `codex remote-control`, runtime enable/disable APIs, status reads, and registry-backed/configured remote environments.

features.name: Python SDK openai-codex
features.description: The Python SDK moved to `openai-codex` / `openai_codex`, with pinned runtime-generated types, concurrent turn routing, approval modes, and integration coverage.

features.name: codex doctor Diagnostics
features.description: Added `codex doctor` for support-ready diagnostics across runtime, auth, terminal, network, config, and local state.

features.name: Python SDK First-Class Authentication
features.description: The Python SDK now supports first-class authentication, including API key login, ChatGPT browser and device-code flows, account inspection, and logout APIs.

features.name: Easier-to-Use Python Turn APIs
features.description: Python turn APIs are easier to use for text-only workflows: you can pass a plain string as input, and handle-based runs now return a richer `TurnResult` with collected items, timing, and usage data.

features.name: `codex exec resume` with `--output-schema`
features.description: `codex exec resume` now accepts `--output-schema`, so resumed automations can keep session context while still enforcing structured JSON output.

features.name: Faster TUI Startup
features.description: TUI startup is faster because terminal capability probes are now batched instead of waiting on several serial checks before the first interactive frame.

features.name: Auth-Backed Remote Executor Registration
features.description: Remote executor registration can now use standard Codex auth instead of a separate registry credential flow.

features.name: App-Server Image Fidelity Preservation
features.description: App-server turns can preserve requested image fidelity, including original-resolution local images, across user inputs and image-producing tools.

features.name: Dedicated Goals Storage
features.description: Goals are now enabled by default, backed by dedicated storage, and track progress across active turns.

features.name: Improved Remote Control CLI UX
features.description: `codex remote-control` now runs like a foreground command, waits for readiness, reports machine status, and keeps explicit daemon-style `start`/`stop` commands.

features.name: Permission Profiles Enhancements
features.description: Permission profiles gained list APIs, inheritance, managed `requirements.toml` support, runtime refresh behavior, and stronger Windows sandbox integration.

features.name: Plugin Discovery Improvements
features.description: Plugin discovery is easier to inspect, with marketplace-aware list output, installed versions, visible marketplace roots, and remote collection support.

features.name: Extension Lifecycle Events
features.description: Extensions can observe more lifecycle events, including subagent start/stop, tool execution, turn metadata, and async approval/turn processing.

features.name: Local Conversation History Search
features.description: Added search across local conversation history, including case-insensitive content matches with result previews.

features.name: Primary Profile Selector
features.description: Made `--profile` the primary profile selector across CLI, TUI permissions, and sandbox flows, with legacy profile configs rejected through migration guidance.

features.name: Improved MCP Setup
features.description: Improved MCP setup with per-server environment targeting and OAuth options for streamable HTTP servers.

features.name: Reliable Connector Tool Schemas
features.description: Made connector tool schemas more reliable by preserving local `$ref`/`$defs` structures and compacting oversized schemas before exposure.

features.name: Concurrent Read-Only MCP Tools
features.description: Let read-only MCP tools run concurrently when they advertise `readOnlyHint`.

features.name: Richer Extension and Hook Context
features.description: Added richer extension and hook context, including conversation history for extension tools and subagent identity in hook inputs.

features.name: Richer environment, Git, terminal, app-server, and thread inventory diagnostics
features.description: `codex doctor` now reports richer environment, Git, terminal, app-server, and thread inventory diagnostics for support cases.

features.name: Remote connection details and server version in /status
features.description: `status` shows remote connection details and server version when the TUI is connected over a remote transport.

features.name: Vim mode text-object editing, improved word/line-end behavior, and a configurable interrupt-turn binding
features.description: Vim mode gained text-object editing, improved word/line-end behavior, and a configurable interrupt-turn binding.

features.name: Named permission profile support in /permissions
features.description: `/permissions` now understands named permission profiles and displays configured custom profiles.

features.name: Bundled patched zsh helper discovery and usage
features.description: Packaged Codex builds can discover and use the bundled patched zsh helper across supported macOS and Linux targets.

features.name: Python SDK sandbox presets
features.description: The Python SDK now exposes friendly `Sandbox` presets for thread and turn APIs.

features.name: Named Sessions, Pinned Threads, and Side Conversations
features.description: Users can now name new sessions using `/new` or `/clear`, pin important threads for easy access, and switch between side conversations without closing them, improving session management and multitasking.
key_details: Switch between side conversations without closing them.

features.name: Agent Plugins Manifests, Workspace Plugin Publishing, and Additional Plugin Marketplaces
features.description: Introduces support for Agent Plugins manifests, enables publishing plugins directly from a workspace, and expands available plugin marketplaces to include Amazon Bedrock and Claude Code.
key_details: New plugin marketplaces for Amazon Bedrock and Claude Code.

features.name: Fork Threads with Paginated History and Temporary Forks
features.description: Allows users to fork threads, now with paginated history. This also includes the ability to create temporary forks that do not appear in the main thread listings, useful for experimentation.
key_details: Create temporary forks that are not listed.

features.name: App-Server to Remote Code Mode Hosts over WebSocket
features.description: The app-server can now connect to remote Code Mode hosts using WebSocket, enhancing flexibility for development environments.
key_details: App-server connects to remote Code Mode hosts.

features.name: Standalone Web Search for Compatible Custom Model Providers
features.description: Enables standalone web search functionality for custom model providers that are compatible, expanding search capabilities beyond built-in providers.
key_details: Standalone web search for compatible custom model providers.

features.name: Discover Executor-Provided Skills and Secure Resource Reading
features.description: Allows for the discovery of skills provided by executors and securely reading their associated resources, including explicitly selected skills, improving skill management and security.
key_details: Securely read associated resources for skills.

features.name: Portable Agent Plugins and Search
features.description: Users can now install portable Agent Plugins and search across local, personal, workspace, and remote plugin catalogs. This enhances plugin discoverability and management.

features.name: Persistent, Manually Ordered Conversation Sections
features.description: Conversations can now be organized into persistent, manually ordered sections, and long transcripts can be browsed incrementally. This improves conversation management and navigation.

features.name: Automatically Reviewed Approvals
features.description: A new CLI flag, `--approve-for-me`, enables automatically reviewed approvals, streamlining workflows that require user confirmation.

features.name: Import Cursor-managed Skills and Synchronize Conversations
features.description: Users can now import Cursor-managed skills and synchronize changes to imported Claude and Cursor conversations without creating duplicates, improving interoperability.
key_details: Synchronize changes to imported Claude conversations
Synchronize changes to imported Cursor conversations

features.name: Opt-in MCP 2026-07-28 Protocol Support
features.description: Support for the opt-in MCP 2026-07-28 protocol has been added, including paginated discovery, multi-round requests, and non-blocking server startup, enhancing MCP capabilities.

features.name: Cached Web Search and Remote Conversation Compaction for Amazon Bedrock
features.description: Cached web search and remote conversation compaction are now enabled for Amazon Bedrock, improving performance and efficiency for Bedrock users.
key_details: Cached web search for Amazon Bedrock
Remote conversation compaction for Amazon Bedrock

features.name: Export TUI Conversations to Markdown
features.description: Users can now export complete TUI conversations to Markdown format. This export can be directed to the clipboard or saved to a new file.

features.name: Fork, Archive, and Restore Sessions
features.description: New capabilities to fork sessions using `codex exec fork`, and to archive or restore sessions directly from the TUI resume picker.
key_details: Command: `codex exec fork` for session forking
TUI resume picker now supports archiving and restoring sessions

features.name: Draft Prompts During TUI Initialization
features.description: The TUI now allows users to draft prompts while it is still initializing. Resume and fork progress is also displayed during startup.
key_details: Composer is editable during TUI startup
Startup displays resume and fork progress

features.name: View Estimated Thread Credits/Cost
features.description: Estimated thread credits or cost can now be viewed in the `/status` command, status lines, and terminal titles for eligible workspaces.

features.name: Amazon Bedrock Runtime as Built-in Provider
features.description: Amazon Bedrock Runtime is now a built-in model provider, offering support for AWS profiles, regions, and GPT-5.6 routing.
key_details: Built-in provider for Amazon Bedrock Runtime
Supports AWS profile and region configuration

features.name: Asynchronous Hooks and MCP Tool Invocation
features.description: Hooks can now execute commands asynchronously and invoke MCP (Multi-Agent Communication Protocol) tools, expanding their capabilities.

features.name: Interactive Agents Dashboard
features.description: An interactive dashboard within the TUI for managing agents. Users can search, start, open, rename, and stop tasks, and configure shortcuts for these actions.
key_details: Search, start, open, rename, and stop tasks.

features.name: TUI Working Directory Commands
features.description: New commands `/cd`, `/pwd`, and `/cwd` are available in TUI sessions for managing the current working directory.

features.name: codex queue command
features.description: A new `codex queue` command allows sending messages to existing local or remote sessions.
key_details: Supports both local and remote sessions.

features.name: Expanded Vim Editing
features.description: Vim editing capabilities have been expanded to include character replacement and additional change motions like `cw`, `c$`, and `cc`.
key_details: New change motions: `cw` (change word), `c$` (change to end of line), `cc` (change line).

features.name: SDK CLI Config Overrides and Reasoning Effort
features.description: SDK users can now pass exact CLI configuration overrides and select 'max' or 'ultra' reasoning effort for agents.
key_details: Pass exact CLI config overrides via the SDK.
Select 'max' or 'ultra' reasoning effort for agents.

features.name: Task Mentions and Management
features.description: Reference other Codex tasks using `@` mentions within the TUI composer. Agents can now read, create, or message tasks directly from the terminal.

features.name: Enhanced /copy Command with Picker
features.description: The `/copy` command now provides a picker interface, allowing users to select whether to copy full responses, individual code blocks, or blockquotes.
key_details: Picker for full responses, code blocks, and blockquotes.

features.name: Automatic Descriptive Terminal Titles and /rename Suggestions
features.description: Unnamed terminal tasks now automatically receive descriptive titles. The `/rename` command suggests an editable title based on the current conversation context.

features.name: Clickable Markdown Links in TUI
features.description: Markdown links are now rendered as clickable labels in supported terminals, while their visible URLs are retained in other contexts.
key_details: Links are clickable in compatible terminals.

features.name: Keybindings for Cycling Permission Modes
features.description: Users can now bind shortcuts to cycle through different permission modes within the TUI.
key_details: Configurable keybindings for permission mode switching.

features.name: Vim Mode Dot Repeat
features.description: Vim mode now supports the `.` command to repeat the last edit.
key_details: Repeat last edit with `.` in Vim mode.

features.name: Interrupt Hooks
features.description: New `Interrupt` hooks can be configured to run commands or MCP handlers when an active top-level turn is interrupted.
key_details: Can execute commands or MCP handlers.

features.name: Configurable Grace Period for MCP Tool Discovery
features.description: Introduced a configurable grace period for discovering tools from optional MCP (Multi-Agent Communication Protocol) servers.

features.name: Extensions Can Inspect/Replace MCP Tool Results
features.description: Extensions now have the capability to inspect or replace the results of MCP tool calls before these results are passed to the model.

features.name: Plugin Catalogs Combine Per-Repository Config and Report Invalid Marketplaces
features.description: Plugin catalogs now integrate per-repository configuration settings and will report invalid project marketplaces without suppressing the display of valid plugins.

breaking_changes.title: Permission profiles behavior change
breaking_changes.description: Permission profiles forward-compatibility: newer profiles now degrade safely on older builds. Legacy workspace-write behavior preserved. Some configs that relied on older behavior may behave differently.
breaking_changes.migration: Review permission profile configs after upgrading. Test that sandbox policy behaves as expected. Use permission-profiles forward-compat config syntax.

breaking_changes.title: Legacy Artifact Tool Removal
breaking_changes.description: The legacy artifact tool and the old `read_file` and `grep_files` handlers have been removed.
breaking_changes.migration: Use alternative methods for accessing and processing files.

breaking_changes.title: Legacy notify deprecation reverted
breaking_changes.description: The deprecation of legacy notify has been reverted.

breaking_changes.title: TurnContext cwd and resolve_path Deprecation
breaking_changes.description: The `cwd` and `resolve_path` fields in `TurnContext` are deprecated.
breaking_changes.migration: Use the selected environment cwd for filesystem helpers.

breaking_changes.title: Legacy [profiles] Rejection
breaking_changes.description: Legacy [profiles] are rejected when using profile-v2.

breaking_changes.title: Legacy Permissions Instructions Helper Removal
breaking_changes.description: The legacy permissions instructions helper has been removed.
breaking_changes.migration: Update code to use the new permission system.

breaking_changes.title: Thread Permission Profiles Removal
breaking_changes.description: The app-server no longer returns thread permission profiles.
breaking_changes.migration: Update code to use the new permission system.

breaking_changes.title: Profile Configuration Migration
breaking_changes.description: Legacy profile configurations are now rejected, requiring migration to the new `--profile` flag and associated configuration structure.
breaking_changes.migration: Migrate your profile configurations to be compatible with the `--profile` flag. Refer to the documentation links provided in the error messages for detailed guidance.

breaking_changes.title: Tool Executor Specs Mandatory
breaking_changes.description: Tool executor specs are now mandatory.
breaking_changes.migration: Ensure all tool executors have a spec defined.

breaking_changes.title: Legacy Profile Configuration Removal
breaking_changes.description: Legacy profile configurations are no longer supported. The `--profile` flag is now the primary profile selector across CLI, TUI permissions, and sandbox flows.
breaking_changes.migration: Migrate to the new profile configuration using the guidance provided in the error messages.

breaking_changes.title: Removal of Skill Model Delegation Support
breaking_changes.description: Support for skill model delegation has been removed. This may affect workflows that relied on delegating model responsibilities for skills.
breaking_changes.migration: Review and update any configurations or workflows that previously utilized skill model delegation. Skills should now directly specify their models or rely on default model resolution.

breaking_changes.title: Rejection of Obsolete App-Server Permission Profile Fields
breaking_changes.description: The app-server now rejects obsolete permission profile fields. Configurations using these fields will no longer be valid.
breaking_changes.migration: Update app-server permission profiles to remove any obsolete fields. Refer to the latest permission profile schema for valid entries.

breaking_changes.title: Rejection of Lossy Legacy Permission Projections
breaking_changes.description: Lossy legacy permission projections are now rejected. This ensures that permission profiles are accurately and securely applied.
breaking_changes.migration: Ensure all permission configurations are up-to-date and do not rely on legacy, lossy projections. Migrate to current permission profile formats.

breaking_changes.title: Retirement of Untrusted Approval Policy
breaking_changes.description: The 'untrusted approval policy' has been retired. This policy is no longer supported and will not be honored.
affected: Configurations relying on the 'untrusted approval policy'
breaking_changes.migration: Remove any references to the 'untrusted approval policy' from your configurations. Implement alternative, more secure approval mechanisms if needed.
